name: product-3d-showcase
description: Turn a glTF/GLB product model into a consistent set of marketing assets: multi-angle product images on white or transparent backgrounds with studio lighting and a soft ground shadow, a frame-exact 360° turntable video (WebM, plus MP4 with ffmpeg) and a self-contained web 3D viewer that works offline. Renders locally with three.js; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a glTF/GLB product model into a consistent set of marketing assets: multi-angle product images on white or transparent backgrounds with studio lighting and a soft ground shadow, a frame-exact 360° turntable video (WebM, plus MP4 with ffmpeg) and a self-contained web 3D viewer that works offline. Renders locally with three.js; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 glTF/GLB 产品模型做成一整套统一风格的展示素材：白底或透明底的多角度产品图（影棚灯光、柔和地面阴影）、逐帧精确的 360° 旋转视频（WebM，装了 ffmpeg 再出 MP4），以及可离线打开的网页 3D 展示。用 three.js 在本地渲染，无需 API 密钥。

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg 路径（可选）
ffmpegPath.description: 可选。只有把 360° 视频另存为 MP4 时需要 ffmpeg。默认在 PATH 和 /opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin 中查找。
